reviewed_by: Claude Code, at the operator's request: stop the provider routing loop from rewording commands a project hook keeps denying
reason: Live Core logged 844 native hook denials across 326 provider turns, up to 16 in one turn: the search-routing hook blocks shell find/grep/tree and the model rewords the command, while every call that runs resets the routing deviation count. A hook manifest can now declare route_to tool names; the denial names them (problem, next_action, use_instead), and without route_to the text is unchanged. The routing loop counts completed denials per hook per turn (serial and parallel waves) and the third denial by the same hook ends routing through the existing deviation-limit path. Selected: the new focused tests, the routing/tolerance and tool-loop suites, the native hook suite, the seven project-hook tests of the automation broker suite by node ID (the fixture hook now declares route_to), chat, and the other tests/v3 files matching _ROUTING_DEVIATION_LIMIT, deviation or NativeHook.
exclusions: No UI or settings change, so no frontend, Playwright or LAN Core run. tests/v3/test_universal_agent_tools.py is excluded (it matched only the NativeHook grep and has 17 failures already on origin/main from un-awaited coroutine rot); test_automation_runtime.py is selected only for its project-hook tests, since 4 of its host-mode and network-scope tests already fail on origin/main. test_chat.py::test_runtime_switch_to_equal_limits_needs_no_confirmation_over_target[postgresql] also fails on pristine origin/main.
